title: Chapter 508
paragraphs: Chapter 508
Episode 141. Crash(1)
There were two red skies on the battlefield, and the Crimson Abyss was also unfolding on the side where Zephyrin was.
The Phantom Knights who followed Zephyrin tried their best to suppress her, but they hadn't dealt any significant damage yet.
'How could such a monster have been a 3rd-class researcher and a spy until recently...!'
'The flare went off a while ago, but what's happening?'
'The battle on the other side is also prolonged. Moreover, that black power seems to be aura... Are the 12th class directly fighting?'
'It seems urgent to support from groups 4, 5, 6, and the main force. I have a bad feeling.'
Even though Zephyrin wasn't fully exerting her power in her true form to avoid being identified, and because her leader's condition was still not good,
She successfully held the Phantom Knights at bay. She looked so skilled that those who didn't know her clumsy axe swordsmanship from the Black King's Chae might mistake her for Luna.
However, Zephyrin was just as confused as the Phantom Knights.
'What, that's not aura but the power of chaos. And it's not even Yona Runcandel's chaos... What's going on, Jin?'
The sword qi that Joshua furiously shot out from the edge of Romin Forest looked almost like aura. But Zephyrin immediately recognized it wasn't.
'It doesn't seem like the 4th class or the Black Knight using chaos. It's probably the 2nd class... It's strangely similar to that woman's power, and it's unpleasant.'
But that wasn't the only unpleasant thing.
Zephyrin was aware that the situation in the back, in the Sota Desert, was not looking good.
The storm area formed by the airship Gruenil was gradually narrowing. On the other hand, Kojak and Zipple's dragons seemed to be regaining stability.

'I'm doing all this, but if I can't steal the goods from Jin, I think I won't be able to sleep out of frustration. On second thought, it seems difficult for Caligo and his gang to steal Jin's items with their stupid heads, so what should I do...?'
Zephyrin's gaze returned to Joshua again.
And she was able to find something strange in that battle situation. Apart from the chaos power unleashed by Joshua, there were no signs of aura, aura, and blue flowers.
The meaning of that fact was clear.
'Is the 2nd class fighting alone...?'
There were two reasons that immediately came to Zephyrin's mind.
First, because if the 2nd class used the power of chaos, they could join the escaping Runcandels again after facing the Phantom Knights alone.
Second, sacrifice.
Whether it was the former or the latter, the important thing was that Joshua was left alone.
'Maybe it could be a plan B.'
Rescue Joshua and use him as a hostage for future negotiations with the Runcandels regarding the item. Zephyrin soon reached that conclusion.
Swish!
She dodged the blade of the red abyss stabbing at her back and pulled out a signal flare from her pocket.
"Ugh, Vice Captain! Help! Help! How far is help?"
Aines Caligo, the second daughter of the great Caligo family, had been crying out like this since she made her spectacular sortie from the airship Gruenil.
As she watched Aines, a cold sweat rolled down Bischel's forehead.
It wasn't just because Aines had been recognized as a female demon named Bubar in his head. Although she appeared to be losing her shape, she was surprisingly holding her own in battle.
Quite some time had passed since the battle began, and Aines's ability was proven by the mere fact that she hadn't died yet.
Of course, Bischel didn't highly rate Aines's martial arts or real skills.
'...It's almost like a cockroach-like survival ability. It resembles that disgusting fatty too.'
The reason Aines had been crying for help was not that she was engaged in a legitimate offense and defense with the enemies.
The transcendent regenerative power unique to top-level demons.
Even if her body burst, her head fell off, or her limbs were disassembled, she recovered in an instant and continued to annoy Bischel and the enemies.
"I don't know what's going on with that thing, Hedo."
Octavia shrugged her shoulders and said. If Bischel equated Aines with Bubar, Octavia felt she was similar to Sandra.
"…I'm also surprised that she's so different from the demon I fought earlier."
Octavia seemed to have no doubt about Hedo's lie. Hedo felt a little sorry for her.
"That demon may be a bit laughable, but honestly, the airship Gruenil is...shocking."
With just one airship that didn't seem to be in perfect condition, and a clumsy demon with only good regenerative power.
Octavia barely accepted the fact that they had been holding out against the main forces she had been leading.

"It's an airship that has already endured the Sword Emperor's sword. Seeing the prestige of their airship, it seems that the sword hasn't become dull. But now it looks like it's gradually being pushed back."
"If you hadn't destroyed the armor and the shield, it would still be tense. If it weren't for the demon that hurt you, we would have already grasped the winning move."

As she said, Gruenil was now in a destroyed state compared to the beginning. More than half of the spikes forming the storm had lost their function, and the ship's cannons were no longer a threat except for the main guns.
"Anyway, we need to decide the outcome soon. The situation in the Lomin Forest seems to be getting serious."
Octavia gathered her magic power and spoke. The dragons were gathering their breath again, and the wizards were preparing large-scale magic spells once more.
'We're almost at our limit. If we're exposed to attacks of this level a few more times, escape will be impossible.'
It wasn't a situation like at the Sword Emperor Castle, where the chief could restore Gruenil.
'Hurry up, Zephyrin...!'
As Bishkel clenched his teeth and searched for her in his thoughts, a signal flare burst in the sky above Lomin Forest far away. It was a signal flare set off by Zephyrin.
The members of Gipfel instantly realized that it was not their signal.
'It worked!'
Ainas also saw the signal flare and raised her greatsword to the sky.
"Oh, it's a signal from Zephyrin! I don't know what it is, but our commander has done it! That's our commander! Let's get out of here, deputy commander!"
Kiiiiing-!
A sharp metallic sound of rotation began in Gruenil's power source. It was the power they had been saving while being battered until now.
Those who had operated the Coject knew what that sound meant. It was the sound just before the start of full-speed flight.
"Are they trying to escape? Even after being so damaged, they still had that kind of power left!"
Octavia narrowed her eyes and shouted.
Everyone knew that Gruenil's goal was to buy time from the beginning. However, Gipfel thought that they could destroy Gruenil without the chief's direct appearance, like at the Sword Emperor Castle.
"Hey, hey, hey, deputy commander! I'm still here!"
Bishkel had no intention of rescuing Ainas Caligo and leaving.
It wasn't just because he disliked her, but because exposing their weakness while boarding would be too dangerous.
'If you die, there's nothing we can do. If you're taken prisoner, we'll negotiate for your release, Ainas Caligo. But please survive on your own, so we don't waste a negotiation.'
Ainas desperately ran towards Gruenil, which had just started turning its hull.
However, she couldn't get close to Gruenil as she was bombarded with Coject's gunfire, Hedo's sword, the wizards' attack spells, and the dragons' breath.
"Deputy commander! You forgot me, ugh! No, cough! Cough! Let's go together!"

Gruenil, which had turned towards Lomin Forest, was concentrating all its remaining power on the rear shield and acceleration. The Coject was not fast enough, and the dragons barely followed, breathing fire but not causing any more damage.
The huge barrier created by the wizards shattered as it collided with the front of Gruenil.
At that moment, Hedo explosively threw himself towards Gruenil with a leap.
"Whoa!"
Ainas, who was standing in his path, was blown away by the shockwave caused by Hedo's acceleration, and Octavia created a gust of wind with her magic power to match Hedo's leap.
Swoosh-!
Twenty lines of sword energy erupted like a storm from the floating longsword veil in the air.
As Octavia said, if it hadn't been for the injury, Hedo's sword energy would have certainly shattered Grenil's rear barrier and stopped it from accelerating at full speed.
'It was a bit shallow.'
The sword energy barely grazed the rear barrier.
At the same time, the heat and turbulence emitted by Grenil's power source engulfed Hedo's body and the dragons following him.
In the midst of it all, Hedo scattered sword energy in all directions to protect the dragons, allowing them to barely descend and avoid the impact.
However, Ainas was once again sent flying somewhere by Grenil's shockwave.
"Chase them!"
Octavia's eyes burned with dark flames as she shouted, receiving Hedo at the forefront of the Kozak.
Meanwhile, beyond the Lomin Forest, on the central border of the Lutero Magical Federation.
A woman in a white dress was shaking off the blood on her longsword. The man standing in front of her was covered in bruises and cuts, and he was breathing heavily with his left arm missing.
It was Bianca Kaligo, the 1st princess of the Kaligo family, and the Black Knight Mon.
'He suddenly stopped moving...'
Mon encountered her while escaping from the construction site. He had been fighting her ever since, unable to fend off her sudden attack.
No, could it even be called a fight? It was so one-sided. Although he had been fighting all along in the construction site and his stamina was depleted, Mon was sure.
Bianca was an opponent he could not handle, even if he fought in his best condition.
The only reason Mon was still alive was because Bianca suddenly stopped attacking as if she was bewitched by something.
'Are the ones who escaped with the magic tower... alright? I must escape from this monster and request support from the family. I must. But, what on earth is she staring at so intently?'
What Bianca was looking at was the signal flare fired by Zephyrin.
"Uh, um, that... it's the Grand Duke's signal. I should go. What should I do...?"
Her slow, muffled voice showed that Bianca was conflicted.
Whether to finish off the human in front of her or to leave as quickly as possible.
"The Grand Duke... his words should come first. I'll be scolded if I don't follow. You're lucky, human. And it was fun."
After saying that, Bianca quickly ran toward the Lomin Forest and disappeared.
It was incomprehensible why she ran leisurely even though it was such an important signal and she possessed such incredible physical abilities that could easily crush him.
